notes: I replaced the quadratic-plus-smoothstep model with piecewise linear interpolation through all observed data points, because E6 revealed the transition is not symmetric (positive ramp slope ~70/unit, negative ~124/unit) and the large-|x| behavior is not a clean quadratic (curvature grows with |x|, so a single quadratic fit misses by up to 8%). The dead zone at |x|≤7 is preserved.
